options.content:
### Historical charges, not equivalent memberships
**Overview:** unaltered advertised charges for three selected Dubai offers on their last complete monthly-price date; tax treatment may be unknown or differ. Original plan names and readable access/billing/commitment terms remain in the evidence table. Marketing names are not converted into invented equivalent tiers.

**Filtered chart:** monthly charges with matching access, known commitment, payment structure, renewal policy and membership-price VAT basis, for **at least two gyms** on the overview date. Unknown/conflicting terms are excluded. Upfront fees, tax rates, cancellation notice, promotions and benefits may still differ; this is **not an all-in-cost or value ranking**. VAT-excluded groups show pre-VAT charges, not amounts payable. No tax rate or missing fee is assumed. Joining/admin fees are disclosed separately, not added to the bars. Filters do not hide the overview or evidence history.

**Freshness:** check each **Observed** date in the evidence history; this is not a live feed. The separately documented 22 October audit found extra fees and unresolved Warehouse access. Do not assume every historical record incorporates those findings.

panels.title: Historical advertised monthly charges · tax and terms may differ
panels.description: Unaltered historical source amounts on the last complete selected date, not tax-normalized prices or equivalent memberships. Unknown/mixed VAT and other terms remain in evidence; use the filtered chart for a known matching VAT basis.

targets.rawSql:
WITH expected_offers (brand_name, branch_name, plan_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('GymNation', 'Downtown Dubai', 'Core'),
    ('PureGym', 'Dubai Al Barsha', 'CORE'),
    ('The Warehouse Gym', 'IBN Battuta Mall', 'Light Monthly')
), eligible AS (
  SELECT m.brand_name, m.branch_name, m.plan_name, m.observed_on, m.advertised_price_aed
  FROM memberships AS m
  JOIN expected_offers USING (brand_name, branch_name, plan_name)
  WHERE m.access_scope = 'single_branch'
    AND m.billing_period_months = 1
    AND m.advertised_price_aed IS NOT NULL
), offers_by_date AS (
  SELECT brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, observed_on,
    MIN(advertised_price_aed) AS advertised_price_aed
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, observed_on
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT advertised_price_aed) = 1
), complete_dates AS (
  SELECT observed_on
  FROM offers_by_date
  GROUP BY observed_on
  HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expected_offers)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY brand_name) > 1
  THEN brand_name || ' · ' || branch_name || ' · ' || plan_name
  ELSE brand_name END AS "Offer",
  advertised_price_aed::double precision AS "Advertised charge",
  observed_on::text AS "Observed"
FROM offers_by_date
WHERE observed_on = (SELECT MAX(observed_on) FROM complete_dates)
ORDER BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name

targets.rawSql:
WITH expected_offers (brand_name, branch_name, plan_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('GymNation', 'Downtown Dubai', 'Core'),
    ('PureGym', 'Dubai Al Barsha', 'CORE'),
    ('The Warehouse Gym', 'IBN Battuta Mall', 'Light Monthly')
), eligible AS (
  SELECT m.brand_name, m.branch_name, m.plan_name, m.observed_on, m.advertised_price_aed
  FROM memberships AS m
  JOIN expected_offers USING (brand_name, branch_name, plan_name)
  WHERE m.access_scope = 'single_branch'
    AND m.billing_period_months = 1
    AND m.advertised_price_aed IS NOT NULL
), offers_by_date AS (
  SELECT brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, observed_on,
    MIN(advertised_price_aed) AS advertised_price_aed
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, observed_on
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT advertised_price_aed) = 1
), complete_dates AS (
  SELECT observed_on
  FROM offers_by_date
  GROUP BY observed_on
  HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expected_offers)
), matching_terms AS (
  SELECT o.brand_name, o.branch_name, o.plan_name, o.observed_on,
    o.advertised_price_aed
  FROM offers_by_date AS o
  JOIN memberships AS m USING (brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, observed_on)
  WHERE o.observed_on = (SELECT MAX(observed_on) FROM complete_dates)
  GROUP BY o.brand_name, o.branch_name, o.plan_name, o.observed_on, o.advertised_price_aed
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ROW(m.access_scope, m.billing_period_months, m.minimum_commitment_months, m.payment_structure, m.renewal_policy, m.price_vat_status)) = 1
    AND MIN(m.access_scope) = ${access_scope:sqlstring}
    AND MIN(m.billing_period_months) = 1
    AND MIN(m.minimum_commitment_months)::text = ${commitment:sqlstring}
    AND MIN(m.payment_structure) = ${payment_structure:sqlstring}
    AND MIN(m.renewal_policy) = ${renewal_policy:sqlstring}
    AND MIN(m.price_vat_status) = ${price_vat_status:sqlstring}
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT * FROM matching_terms
  WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand_name) FROM matching_terms) >= 2
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM complete_dates)
    THEN 'Not enough comparable offers — no complete monthly observation date'
  WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand_name) FROM matching_terms) = 1
    THEN 'Not enough comparable offers — 1 gym matches; at least 2 required'
  WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand_name) FROM matching_terms) < 2
    THEN 'Not enough comparable offers — ' ||
      (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand_name) FROM matching_terms)::text ||
      ' gyms match; at least 2 required'
  ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT brand_name) FROM matching_terms)::text ||
    ' gyms match access and commitment, payment, renewal and price VAT basis — fees, tax rates, notice and benefits may differ'
  END AS "Comparison status"

panels.title: Monthly advertised charges · ${price_vat_status:text}
panels.description: Requires the same selected access, known commitment, payment structure, renewal policy and membership-price VAT basis for at least two brands on the overview date. Excluded-VAT prices are pre-VAT charges, not payable totals. No assumed rates, tax conversion or upfront-fee addition. Unknown/conflicting classification excludes an offer. Fees, tax rates, cancellation notice and benefits may differ.

panels.title: Recorded offers and normalized terms · all observation dates

targets.rawSql:
SELECT brand_name AS "Gym", branch_name AS "Branch", plan_name AS "Original plan name",
  CASE access_scope WHEN 'single_branch' THEN 'Single branch'
    WHEN 'multiple_named_branches' THEN 'Specified branches'
    WHEN 'all_uae_branches' THEN 'All operator UAE branches'
    ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Access",
  advertised_price_aed::double precision AS "Advertised price AED",
  CASE WHEN billing_period_months IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN billing_period_months = 1 THEN '1 month'
    ELSE billing_period_months::text || ' months' END AS "Payment covers",
  CASE WHEN minimum_commitment_months IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN minimum_commitment_months = 0 THEN 'No minimum commitment'
    WHEN minimum_commitment_months = 1 THEN '1 month'
    ELSE minimum_commitment_months::text || ' months' END AS "Minimum commitment",
  CASE payment_structure WHEN 'prepaid_term' THEN 'Prepaid term'
    WHEN 'recurring' THEN 'Recurring payments' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Payment structure",
  CASE renewal_policy WHEN 'automatic' THEN 'Automatic renewal'
    WHEN 'non_automatic' THEN 'No automatic renewal' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Renewal",
  CASE price_vat_status WHEN 'included' THEN 'VAT included'
    WHEN 'excluded' THEN 'VAT excluded' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Membership price VAT",
  joining_fee_aed::double precision AS "Joining fee AED",
  admin_fee_aed::double precision AS "Admin fee AED",
  COALESCE(INITCAP(offer_type), 'Unknown') AS "Offer type",
  observed_on::text AS "Observed", source_published_on::text AS "Published",
  source_url AS "Source", notes AS "Conditions / unknowns"
FROM memberships
ORDER BY observed_on DESC, brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, id

panels.description: All recorded observations, newest first. Unknown prices remain visible; amounts cover the displayed billing period, not necessarily a month. Original plan names are traceability, not comparison categories. This history is not filtered by the chart selectors. Membership price VAT does not establish fee tax treatment. Joining/admin amounts are separate one-time charges as quoted; unknown is not zero. No total-cost calculation is implemented.

list.name: commitment
list.label: Comparison minimum commitment
list.definition: Known commitment values for the selected offers; no minimum is always an available choice.
list.query:
WITH expected_offers (brand_name, branch_name, plan_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('GymNation', 'Downtown Dubai', 'Core'),
    ('PureGym', 'Dubai Al Barsha', 'CORE'),
    ('The Warehouse Gym', 'IBN Battuta Mall', 'Light Monthly')
)
SELECT CASE WHEN months = 0 THEN 'No minimum commitment'
  WHEN months = 1 THEN '1 month' ELSE months::text || ' months' END AS __text,
  months::text AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS months
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT minimum_commitment_months
  FROM memberships JOIN expected_offers USING (brand_name, branch_name, plan_name)
  WHERE minimum_commitment_months IS NOT NULL
) AS commitments
ORDER BY months

list.label: Comparison renewal
list.query: Automatic renewal : automatic,No automatic renewal : non_automatic
